answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen pricing, making renewal unlikely to meet the mandated 18% spend reduction. The archived record for the low-cost vendor is the most decision-relevant evidence because it may validate prior onboarding speed and cost reduction. However, with contract expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% utilization, primary-switch delivery performance cannot be assumed from prior cost and invoicing results; any switch should be gated and limited until supply continuity is verified.
